chapter: Teddy Wilson, Cafe Society and bebop
title: The Golden Gate Ballroom and the Savoy's rivalry
summary: The Wilson band formed at the Golden Gate on Lenox Avenue, where times were bad and the Savoy wanted to buy out its competitor.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: And where did you form with Wilson?
At the Golden Gate Ballroom, on Lennox Avenue.
I see. And so you were now living in New York?
Uh-huh. And what was -- what was that like -- there were a lot of after-hours clubs, weren't there?
Well there were after-hours clubs but not too many of them at that time, because things were very
bad in New York at that time.

And the Savoy was, naturally, trying to close the Golden Gate. I learned at that time that they wanted to buy out the Golden Gate, because it was competition. Cause the Golden Gate was taking a lot of trade away from the Savoy at that time.
